description: Sixteen rows of clock dividers, one to sixteen left to right, each row giving a trigger when the count lands on the divisions turned on in it

params.text: Turns every cell in the grid off
Clears the grid and fills it with random cells
Sets how full the grid is left after a randomise

inputs.text: Each trigger here advances the count by one step
A trigger here sends the count back to its first step
Clears the grid and fills it with random cells
Turns the grid a quarter turn clockwise
Moves every cell up one row

outputs.text: A trigger whenever the count lands on any of the divisions turned on in that row
A trigger whenever the count lands on exactly one of the divisions turned on in that row
The OR trigger of every row in one polyphonic signal
The XOR trigger of every row in one polyphonic signal

notes: click a cell in the grid to turn it on or off, and drag across the grid to paint a run of them
menu: Polyphony channels — sets how many channels the merged OR and XOR outputs carry
